hints.content:
Function $\redD g$ is shifted $6$ units left relative to $\blueD f$. 



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A parabola f and its shifted graph g are on an x y coordinate plane. The x- and y- axes scale by one. Graph f is concave up and has a vertex around (three, two). Graph g is concave up and has a vertex around (negative three, two). An arrow points from (three, two) to (negative three, two).

hints.content:
This means the value of $\redD{g}$ at a number $x$ is the same as the value of $\blueD{f}$ at a number $6$ more than $x$. 

  What would this sentence look like as an equation?

question.content:
$\redD g$ is a transformation of $\blueD f$. The graph below shows $\blueD f$ as a solid blue line and $\redD g$ as a dotted red line.
